The '''Ancient Stasis Zone''' was the name given to the northernmost section of [[the Tomb]], an ancient [[Prison/Legends|prison]] built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]]. A tropical rift like the other sections of the Tomb, the Zone featured several [[Aphor tree]]s, and was connected to various other sections of the Tomb&mdash;the [[Ancient Rakatan Keep]] to the south by the [[Lavaflow Traverse]], the [[Warlord's Deep]] by the [[Icewall Ravine]] to the west, and [[Frozencavern Canyon]] to the east. The [[Oasis Republic Post]] was located in the Zone, and the walls of the zone were lined by Rakatan stasis vaults, many of which were damaged during the [[invasion of Belsavis]]&mdash;the [[Primal Destroyer]] was released and began roaming the [[Waters of the Primal Destroyer|lake]] in the middle of the zone.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ancient Stasis Zone appears a subregion of the Tomb on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
